item.title: Embedded Article
item.content:encoded:
This is the full article body delivered right inside the feed via content:encoded. It is substantially longer than the teaser summary, so the poller should store it as full_content without ever fetching the page.

It also carries a link and a that the sanitizer must scrub before storage.
